what_happened: Two of the five dispatch-named edit targets (ref-plumbing-landing.md, repo-level-declarations.md) were found already current: the implementing tasks (per_task_attribution_squash_landing, integration_branch_admission_and_batch_worktree) kept them in sync with the code in the same dispatch round. Verified against live scripts, not just the records.

context/contracts/conclusion-stage.md (line ~414) still describes the retired milestone-ref-land.sh landing mechanism and a refs/heads/milestone/<id> review ref; milestone-review-handoff.sh was rewritten by per_task_attribution_squash_landing to read the integration branch and landing proofs instead. This file is not in task 675's declared file_scope; its own implementing task's report named it as belonging to 675. Recommended for file_scope addition at plan time.

shared-worktree-discipline.md's opening sentence calls per-agent worktree isolation a settled non-goal without distinguishing per-dispatch (still removed) from batch-granularity (now a declared-but-unimplemented mode with five held successor tasks). Confirmed stale per the dispatch description's own prediction; git-staging-scope.md, the other sweep-named file, was checked and found NOT stale.

The research report's per-document classification let the plan drop two of the five named edit targets (ref-plumbing-landing.md, repo-level-declarations.md) from the rewrite set to confirm-only, after plan-time re-verification against the live scripts agreed; this removed roughly half the anticipated editing surface without weakening any verification criterion.

Two confirmed-stale sweep targets (context/contracts/conclusion-stage.md, context/standards/shared-worktree-discipline.md) sat outside the task's creation-time file_scope in specs/state.json. Resolved at plan time by declaring both in a phase's Files to modify block, which plan-file-scope-harvest.sh harvests and plan postflight forwards to update-task-status.sh --file-scope-add; verified the harvest emits all 8 paths including the whole-tree sentinel.
